model.title: A bill to require the United States Postal Service to designate ZIP Codes for certain communities.
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee · Sen. Joni Ernst (R-IA)

summary.text: The bill would require the United States Postal Service to create new ZIP Codes for specific communities that currently lack their own dedicated postal codes.
